name: Mr. President's Best Day Ever
source: Being the President isn't a hard job—you just need to steer clear of any policy decisions, avoid insensitive comments on camera, and never, ever leave the White House. Any shmuck can do that. Except the current President, of course. Which makes your job much, much harder. A kinetic visual novel about the unsung bureaucratic heroes/villains/idiots that keep America running (straight into the ground).
translation: 成为总统并不是一件艰苦的工作——你只需要避开任何政策决定，避免在镜头前发表不敏感的评论，并且永远、永远离开白宫。任何傻瓜都可以做到这一点。当然，现任总统除外。这让你的工作变得非常非常困难。一部关于让美国继续运转（直接陷入困境）的无名官僚英雄/恶棍/白痴的动态视觉小说。
